Our story

One family, one city, four decades of hospitality.

Mayur Hospitality Group began with a single restaurant. In 1981 Chef Pramod Sharma opened Mayur in Amsterdam, bringing traditional North Indian cuisine to the city in an atmosphere that felt warm, personal and refined.

In 2000 the next generation took responsibility. Rather than reinventing what had been built, they chose gradual evolution, raising the standard of cuisine, service and guest experience while keeping the character intact.

From that foundation the group has grown into café dining, residences, consultancy, curated retail and, next, a villa project on the Tuscan coast. Each concept is different. They share the same attention to how a guest feels.

Mayur

Indian Fine Dining · Amsterdam · Since 1981

Established
1981
Concept
Indian fine dining
Location
Amsterdam, NL

Where our story began.

Mayur was founded in Amsterdam in 1981 by Chef Pramod Sharma, with the ambition of introducing traditional North Indian cuisine in an atmosphere that felt warm, personal and refined.

More than four decades later, that original philosophy remains at the heart of Mayur.

The kitchen is rooted in the culinary traditions of North India. Meats are carefully marinated, the traditional charcoal-fired tandoor remains central to the cooking, and curries are prepared with the depth, patience and balance that have defined the restaurant for generations.

Over the years, Mayur has evolved from a pioneering Indian restaurant into an Indian fine-dining experience. The surroundings, service and presentation have become increasingly refined, while the character of the food and the personal approach have been deliberately preserved.

Two generations. One continuing story.

In 2000, the next generation took responsibility for Mayur. Rather than reinventing the restaurant, the focus has been on a gradual evolution: respecting what was built by the first generation while continuously raising the standard of cuisine, service and guest experience.

Today, Mayur is not simply one of the concepts within Mayur Group. It is its foundation. It is where our understanding of hospitality began, where many of our values were formed, and where the story continues every evening.

Café 1981

International Café & Brasserie · Amsterdam

Introduced
2024
Concept
International café & brasserie
Location
Amsterdam, NL

A more informal expression of our hospitality.

Café 1981 was created from a simple observation: the character of a place can change throughout the day.

While Mayur comes alive as a fine-dining restaurant, Café 1981 brings another energy to the same Amsterdam setting: relaxed, international and accessible.

Beginning in the morning with breakfast and brunch, the café moves naturally through lunch and into afternoon drinks, cocktails and a light evening menu.

The food is intentionally international rather than Indian. Familiar dishes are prepared and presented with care, creating the kind of café where guests can stop for coffee, meet over lunch or simply watch Amsterdam pass by from the terrace.

1981, seen from a different perspective.

The name is a deliberate connection to our beginnings. Café 1981 takes the heritage of Mayur without trying to reproduce Mayur itself. It shows something that has become increasingly important to Mayur Group: heritage does not have to stand still.

A new generation, a different moment of the day and a completely different concept, connected by the same attention to how a guest feels.

DeRijkssuites

Amsterdam Residences

Established
2017
Concept
Serviced & long-stay residences
Location
Amsterdam, NL

Amsterdam, with the feeling of home.

DeRijkssuites grew from a different side of hospitality. Instead of asking how we wanted guests to dine, we began by asking how we wanted them to live.

Located in one of Amsterdam's most distinctive cultural areas, close to the Rijksmuseum and the city's historic centre, DeRijkssuites offers residences designed for guests who want more than the conventional hotel experience.

Privacy, comfort and independence are at the centre of the concept. The residences are intended to feel personal rather than institutional: places where someone can settle into Amsterdam, whether for a longer stay, an extended business visit or simply a period of living in the city.

Made for living.

DeRijkssuites represents an important step in the development of Mayur Group. It took our experience of welcoming people beyond the restaurant and into residential hospitality.

The philosophy, however, remained remarkably similar: thoughtful surroundings, attention to detail and the belief that genuine comfort often comes from the things that are quietly done well.

Mayur Consultancy

Experience, put into practice.

Concept
Hospitality & concept consultancy
Perspective
Operator-led
Based in
Amsterdam · working internationally

Four decades of hospitality cannot be learned from a textbook.

Mayur Consultancy grew from the practical experience accumulated since 1981: operating restaurants, developing concepts, working with teams, understanding guests and adapting businesses as markets and expectations change.

Our approach is deliberately practical. We look at a hospitality business not only from the perspective of its concept, but through the complete guest journey: positioning, menu, service, atmosphere, operational structure and the details that influence how a business is perceived.

From experience to perspective.

We understand hospitality from the operator's side because we continue to operate our own businesses. That distinction matters. Our recommendations are informed not only by what looks good in a presentation, but by what has to work when the doors open, the team arrives and the first guest walks in.

The purpose is not to make every business look alike. It is to identify what makes a concept distinctive and help make that idea clearer, stronger and more commercially sustainable.

Boutique C

Curated Objects · Coffee · Amsterdam

Opening 2027
Opening
2027
Concept
Curated retail & coffee
Location
Amsterdam, NL

A small place for things worth discovering.

Boutique C is a new concept being developed within Mayur Group. Part boutique, part coffee destination, it will bring together a carefully edited selection of objects, gifts and products chosen for their quality, character and story.

Rather than filling shelves with endless choice, Boutique C will be based on curation: fewer things, better chosen.

Alongside the retail collection, coffee will form an important part of the experience, creating a place where browsing does not need to be rushed and where shopping becomes part of a pleasant moment in the day.

Curiosity as a concept.

Boutique C also represents Mayur Group moving beyond traditional hospitality. It brings together retail, design and the simple pleasure of coffee in a format that is smaller, more intimate and constantly capable of changing.

Products will come and go. New discoveries will appear. The experience should always leave room for curiosity.

San Vincenzo

Boutique Villas · Tuscany

Future development
Concept
Boutique villa resort
Location
San Vincenzo, Tuscany, IT
Status
Future development

From Amsterdam to Tuscany.

San Vincenzo represents a new chapter for Mayur Group, and perhaps our most ambitious evolution so far.

Set within the landscape of the Tuscan coast, the project is envisioned as an intimate collection of private villas where architecture, landscape, privacy and hospitality come together.

Rather than creating a conventional resort, the ambition is to develop something more personal: the independence and space of a private villa combined with the thoughtful details and services of a boutique hospitality experience.

The surroundings are an essential part of the idea. Gardens, outdoor living, swimming, places to gather and quieter spaces to retreat should allow guests to experience Tuscany at a slower rhythm.

A destination shaped by everything before it.

San Vincenzo brings together lessons from every part of the Mayur Group story: decades of welcoming guests at Mayur, the informal character of Café 1981, the residential thinking behind DeRijkssuites and the experience of developing and operating hospitality concepts.

It is not intended to recreate Amsterdam in Italy. It should belong to its landscape. Architecture, materials and gardens will be developed with respect for the character of Tuscany, while the experience carries forward the personal approach that has been part of our family businesses since 1981.

Our vision
Heritage does not have to stand still.

Every new concept starts from what we learned at Mayur in 1981: thoughtful surroundings, attention to detail, and comfort that comes from things quietly done well. We carry that forward into new cities, new moments of the day and new ways of staying.

A family hospitality group from Amsterdam, building on a story that began in 1981.
